verdict.rationale: Bland documents post-call webhooks that automatically notify your server when a call completes, which covers the delivery channel. Evals with LLM judges that grade individual call dimensions give some outcome-style assessment, but nothing in the pack shows configurable structured extraction of entities, dispositions or custom fields into the webhook or API payload. Missing for 10: documented structured-data extraction schema (entities, dispositions, outcomes), evidence of what the post-call webhook payload contains, API retrieval of extracted fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.
